node: Advanced packaging capacity, substrates, inspection, and process equipment
summary: Expanded the universe for the advanced-packaging chokepoint node with one reference capacity owner and two US-listed underfollowed equipment/inspection names. The cleanest reference anchor is TSMC because CoWoS, SoIC, InFO and related advanced-packaging platforms define the demand map. The underfollowed discovery lane favors Camtek for advanced-packaging inspection/metrology and Kulicke & Soffa for assembly tools including thermocompression bonding.
